reason: A skill that guides AI coding agents to trace a feature through a codebase and produce a structured technical implementation document with optional Mermaid diagrams.

summaries.zh: 帮助 AI 编程代理从代码库中追踪指定功能的完整实现链路，并生成包含业务逻辑、数据流、异常处理、依赖关系和 Mermaid 图表的技术文档。
summaries.en: Guides AI coding agents to trace a specified feature through a codebase and generate technical documentation covering business logic, data flow, exception handling, dependencies, and Mermaid diagrams.

capabilities: reads and traces project source code
identifies business logic, data flow, state changes, exception handling, and dependencies
generates technical development documentation with Mermaid diagrams
